'''Masayuki Katō''' (Japanese: '''加藤将之''' ''Katō Masayuki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Katō was born on September 23, 1972, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, where his only role was [[Porter]], a group of cruise ship guides in the [[Decolore Islands]]. Katō was once affiliated with Mausu Promotion, and is currently affiliated with Ken Production.
